statement: In a single-seed MicroLens development ladder, M4 had the highest controlled-cold validation NDCG@20 while M7 had the highest FIT-warm validation NDCG@20; neither variant led both slices.
limitation: Cross-references M0-M7 receipts; no equal HPO, seed qualification, paired intervals, or protected outcome access. This is not a promotion claim.

statement: A three-epoch CUDA GRU4Rec pilot measured validation NDCG@20 of 0.008925 on 41,694 FIT-history MicroLens users.
limitation: No HPO, reference parity, seed qualification, or locked result; not a model-comparison or resume claim.

statement: MOSAIC improves controlled cold NDCG@20 while retaining warm quality.
limitation: MOSAIC finalist, comparators, margins, locked results, and paired bootstrap are not available.

statement: MOSAIC has calibrated reliability-aware gate behavior.
limitation: Intervention and directional gate tests are not complete; gate weights are not probabilities.
Public observational offline data cannot establish production effect.
Only one physical GPU is available and no multi-GPU measurement exists.
